label: Lavish
summary: Review pages: a plan, a decision with options or a grilling round opens as an HTML page the reader annotates and answers, instead of long terminal prose.
why: Runs through npx: nothing stays installed and no API key is read. The page is served from a local server on this machine. A session with no browser prints to the terminal instead.

install.note: Only reached when neither `lavish-axi` nor `npx` is on PATH. With npx present nothing is installed: `npx -y lavish-axi` fetches the package on first use.

verify.failsOn: npx is missing, the registry is unreachable, or the lavish-axi package no longer answers --help.

afterInstall: nothing to wire: `cckit page open <html-file>` opens a page

drifts: the package name lavish-axi on npm
the subcommands cckit passes through (poll, reply, end)
that `lavish-axi <html-file>` opens a session and `--help` exits 0
